The card gives the component sizes 5 and 2 and the count 2." width="100%"} For undirected graphs, counts regular connected components. For directed graphs, treats all edges as undirected (ignoring direction) when finding components. A weakly connected component is a maximal set of nodes where every node is reachable from every other node when edge directions are ignored. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Number of weakly connected components. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Two separate pairs of nodes, with no edges between them, form two components: ::: {#8d5b7ecc .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=False) .add_nodes(["A", "B", "X", "Y"]) .add_edges([("A", "B"), ("X", "Y")]) ) # Returns 2 graph.count_weakly_connected_components() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 2 ``` ::: :::
